title: Freeze selection, size, and ordering experiments
description:
## Scope

Make the central question testable: do many well-chosen examples improve weak initial alignment, and how does that improvement change with example count, selection policy, and presentation order?

## Definition of done

Signed-off preregistrations declare compatible cells, primary contrasts, seeds, budgets, inference, request ceilings, and deviations before live collection. Jev ordering results precede cross-model conclusions.

Selector-by-size preregistration is closed as done; the ordering preregistration and the cross-model rules are moved to backlog. This epic stays open at low priority until they are resumed or dropped by the owner.
